## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Aug 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Evan Metcalfe_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "This app was awesome, so much so that you didn't even mind the couple of ads it had because that meant the app was free. Buy some update must have happened because now I get the same ad for some other fitness app and even though there is a close button, no matter how many times I press it or wait or close and reopen the app, the ad does not close so this app is now completely unusable for me. I cannot even provide feedback in app as the ads start immediately on opening the app"
            2. _Joshua johnston_, Jul 20, 2026, 4/5: "the ads generated in the app will freeze the app itself. other than that the app is phenomenal. I do wish there were a few more unlocked exercises, but as a free app there's nothing missing. logging and generating exercise plans are great and the fact that I can regenerate a single exercise or all of them. 4.2/5"
